description: This Java source file defines the DeleteFeatureStrategy class, an immutable class that handles DeleteFeature commands by deleting specified features from a Thing object, generating appropriate events and responses.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureStrategy
classes.description: Immutable class that implements the strategy to handle DeleteFeature commands by removing features from Things and generating relevant events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete feature command, extracting the feature and generating the deletion result or error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the feature specified in the command from the given Thing, or returns empty if not found.

methods.name: getDeleteFeatureResult
methods.description: Builds the result event and response after successfully deleting the feature.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the previous entity state if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional because deletion does not generate a next entity tag.
